headline: Costco beat estimates with U.S. comps up 5.9% ex gas and 20%+ digital growth; renewal rates dipped slightly.

metrics.comp_label: Costco U.S. comp ex gas & FX

guidance_note: Costco does not give earnings guidance. EPS of $4.50 includes a $0.16 tax benefit ($4.34 excluding it).
key_messages: U.S. comps +5.9% (same ex gas and FX); total company +6.4%; digitally enabled comps +20.5%.
Membership fees ~$1.33B (up from $1.17B) on the Sept 2024 fee hike; paid members ~81.4M.
U.S./Canada renewal rate slipped 10 bps to 92.2% (worldwide 89.7%) on weaker renewal by digitally signed members.
Gross margin ~11.32% vs 11.28% a year earlier.

consumer.pricing: Costco sources globally and monitors tariff costs closely.

macro_read: Solid traffic and comps into the 2025 holidays showed Costco's members still spending steadily, with value-seeking supporting the warehouse model.
notes: EPS of $4.50 includes a $0.16 tax benefit; $4.34 without it. Consensus for this quarter was removed because it could not be confirmed from a source.
